text: 高盛的“国家队”ETF资金流动追踪指标显示，7月13-16日期间净流入达290亿元人民币，这一金额为2025年4月以来最大的四个交易日累计规模。此外，7月17日宽基ETF持续放量。截至收盘，易方达创业板ETF、华泰柏瑞沪深300ETF、华夏科创50ETF全天成交额均超百亿元，分别达到154.27亿元、146.49亿元及142.87亿元。
text_en: Goldman Sachs' 'National Team' ETF flow tracker shows net inflows of RMB 29 billion from July 13-16, the largest four-session cumulative total since April 2025. Additionally, broad-based ETFs saw continued high volume on July 17. At close, the Yi Fund ChiNext ETF, Huatai-PineBridge CSI 300 ETF, and ChinaAMC STAR 50 ETF all posted daily turnover exceeding RMB 10 billion, at RMB 15.427 billion, RMB 14.649 billion, and RMB 14.287 billion respectively.
